gloss: to become defiant; to turn aggressive; to sit up straight

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {居直|いなお}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {居直|いなお}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {居直|いなお}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to become defiant; to turn aggressive
definitions.explanation: to suddenly become confrontational or aggressive, especially when caught doing wrong

definitions.gloss: to sit up straight; to change one's sitting position
definitions.explanation: to adjust from a relaxed position to a formal seated posture

examples.japanese: ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{居直|いなお}った。
⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{居直|いなお}ってきた。
examples.english: When I warned them, they got aggressive.

examples.japanese: {居直|いなお}り⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}った→遭う：09500_au⟧。
examples.english: I was victimized by a burglar who turned violent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}して→正す：10132_tadasu⟧{居直|いなお}った。
examples.english: I straightened my posture and sat up properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{居直|いなお}った。
examples.english: I sat up straight because my boss came.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{居直|いなお}って{座|すわ}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I slowly adjusted my position and sat up properly.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)

KEY COMPOUND:
{居直|いなお}り⟦{強盗|ごうとう}→強盗：02818_goutou⟧ - a burglar who, when discovered, becomes violent and robs the victim. This is a recognized crime category in Japan.

USAGE:
Sense 1 implies a sudden shift from being caught/defensive to being aggressive and confrontational. More aggressive than ⟦{開|ひら}き{直|なお}る→開き直る：08204_hirakinaoru⟧, which is merely becoming defiant.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{開|ひら}き{直|なお}る→開き直る：08204_hirakinaoru⟧ (to become defiant - less aggressive)
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}ギレ→逆ギレ：17470_gyakugire⟧ (getting angry when confronted)
- {座|すわ}り{直|なお}す (to sit up again)

cross_references.label: to become defiant; to brazenly stand one's ground
